regime: Risk-On Bounce, Equities Reclaim Trend Stops (Pre-FOMC Drift)
summary: Friday's failed bounce flipped into a real one. The Nasdaq opened firm, broke its opening range up at 14:15 UTC, ran to a 29,571.75 high, and closed 29,466.75, up 0.99 percent, back above both its trend stop and its 50-period average. The S&P confirmed, up 0.55 percent to 7,714.25 and also back above its stop and average, so breadth matched the tape this time. VIX fell 5.45 percent to 18.39, under 20 again. Gold firmed 0.54 percent and flipped its trailing stop long, though it stayed under its 50-average, and crude gave back part of Friday's spike, down 2.09 percent to 101.27, holding the 100 round. All four contracts closed above their trend stops, a broad risk-on flip, with the Fed decision Wednesday the next hurdle.

risk.openRisk: Measured. Trend stops reclaimed, so index longs are back on the table, but keep size small into Wednesday's Fed decision.
risk.note: Throttle eases from DEFENSIVE to REDUCED. Equities reclaimed their trend stops and 50-averages and VIX fell below 20, so the defensive index-long block lifts and the long-only momentum edge is unblocked. The Fed decision is Wednesday Oct 28 at 2 pm Eastern, so keep size measured and avoid oversized positions into the event. No drawdown flags and the loss budget is full. Gold flipped its stop long but is still under its 50-average, so that turn is unconfirmed. Crude holds its 100.71 stop but is cooling. VIX near 18.4 keeps both sides live but calmer.

psychology: Friday the bounce could not reclaim the line that broke, so it was a pullback in a downtrend. Today it reclaimed, and that is the difference between a dead-cat bounce and a trend repair. The lesson is patience on both sides. Friday, waiting for acceptance back above the stop kept you out of a weak pop. Today, two hourly closes back above the stop and the average gave the trend-up read some proof. Let the level decide, then size. Into Wednesday's Fed decision, keep that discipline and do not pre-position for a surprise.
